verdict.rationale: CDP documents its own fully isolated Sandbox for custodial features, with no real funds and the same endpoints, auth and response formats as Live. Its only documented deterministic test inputs are magic SSN values for verification outcomes, and the docs never state that the sandbox covers payment acceptance, payouts or conversions. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox coverage of checkout/payment acceptance, payouts and conversions; deterministic test values for payment, payout and conversion outcomes; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rehearse everything without real funds — a documented sandbox or testnet mode covering payments, payouts, and conversions with test values that behave deterministically

citations.quote: Sandbox is a fully isolated testing environment for custodial features without connecting real funds.
It uses the same endpoints, authentication, and response formats as Live, so there's nothing new to learn when you're ready to ship.
test verification outcomes with [magic SSN values]
